name: Dead Drop
author: The Dead Drop
description: Your Dead Drop in the bar: an envelope, dim when there's no mail, a count when there is, red for urgent. Click for your inbox: read a message, archive it, put it back.

barWidget.description: Your Dead Drop inbox (reads deaddrop watch's inbox file). Click for the inbox; right click checks now. omarchy-shell deaddrop open opens it on the focused monitor.
